correctness.rationale: In RESULT.md, expand f(x)=a x^2+b x^3+c x^4+o(x^4), a>0, and invert the signed square-root coordinate to order z^3. The two intersections have width L(y)=2sqrt(y/a)(1+qy+o(y)), q=5b²/(8a³)-c/(2a²). Integrate L and yL over [0,h]; dividing yields d(h)/h=3/5+12 qh/175+o(h). Since S(h)=(4/(3sqrt(a)))h^(3/2)(1+o(1)), substitution of D2f=2a,D3f=6b,D4f=24c gives precisely the boxed coefficient times k_ea=D4f/(3D2f^(5/3))-5 D3f²/(9D2f^(8/3)). Uniform little-oh in the local inverse and positive curvature justify the order. For conic A x²+2Bxy+C y²=Dy the chord-width factor sqrt(1+(B²-AC)y/(AD)) is monotone, and covariance against baseline density u^(1/2) proves ellipse/parabola/hyperbola inequalities on admissible finite cap ranges. We independently checked the inverse series algebra and exact centroid deficit, not merely a code marker.
